aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64:cli:1.policyDescription: Allows access to restart and stop DDA greengrass components

aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64:cli:2.policyDescription: Allows access to list and get details for greengrass components on device

aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64:shadow:.policyDescription: Allows access to things with shadows

aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64:mqttpro.policyDescription: Allows access to shadow pubsub topics

Allows workflow mqtt_publish output publishes: the node topic parameter is free-form user input, so no topic prefix can cover it and publish must be authorized on the wildcard resource. Deliberately publish-only; SubscribeToIoTCore is NOT broadened beyond the shadow topics in mqttproxy:1

ComponentDescription: DDA Local Web Server App - AMD64

Install.Script: docker images --quiet --filter=dangling=true | xargs --no-run-if-empty docker rmi -f || true; docker load -i {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64-x86_64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64/flask-app.tar && docker load -i {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64-x86_64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64/react-webapp.tar

Shutdown.Script:
export $(grep -v '^#' /tmp/.dda.env | xargs) || true
docker compose --profile ${DOCKER_PROFILE:-generic} -f {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64-x86_64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64/docker-compose.yaml down
bash {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64-x86_64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64/host_scripts/compose_lifecycle.sh wait-empty 240 -- --profile ${DOCKER_PROFILE:-generic} -f {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64-x86_64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.amd64/docker-compose.yaml || true
